description: Hyperparameter tuning of the TensorFlow (Keras) and PyTorch models with Optuna. For each library, problem and architecture, n_trials configurations are drawn from the search space by a seeded TPE sampler and scored on the validation set of tuning_seed's split only. The best configuration is then trained and tested once on every seed's split. Training settings (epochs, early stopping) come from each library's section in benchmark_experiments.json.
